info.disclaimer: This is a short summary, not legal advice or an offer. Read the full terms before buying.

how.title: How it works
how.intro: In short: you buy a card, start it, it earns income, and after the cycle the money comes back to your wallet.

card.title: What a card is
card.text: A card is tied to a fixed amount in BTC (its face value) and has an annual rate. You pay for it in dollars at the current BTC rate.

start.title: Start
start.text: A purchased card earns nothing until you start it. Once started, income accrues every minute.

cycle.title: Stopping
cycle.text: When you stop a card, its income is fixed and the card goes on a 30-day pause.

pause.title: After the pause
pause.text: After 30 days, the purchase price plus the fixed income is credited to your wallet automatically. A card that has finished its cycle can't be started again.

sell.title: Selling a card
sell.text: Only a card that hasn't been started can be sold. You get back exactly its purchase price, regardless of the current BTC rate.

wallet.title: Wallet
wallet.text: Deposits and withdrawals go through the wallet. Each request is checked by an administrator manually.

risks.title: Where income comes from and risks
risks.intro: Please read this before buying a card.

source.title: Where income comes from
source.text: Income is accrued by the service at the card's annual rate. The rate is set by the service and is not guaranteed.

rate.title: The rate can change
rate.text: The annual rate of a series may be changed. Past income doesn't guarantee future income.

btc.title: BTC rate
btc.text: Card value and income are tied to BTC, so their dollar amount goes up and down with the BTC price.

manual.title: Manual processing
manual.text: Deposits and withdrawals are confirmed by an administrator manually. Processing takes time and a request may be rejected.

loss.title: You may lose money
loss.text: As with any crypto product, there is a risk of losing part or all of the funds. Only use money you can afford to lose.

cards.title: Cards
cards.text: A card is a digital product with a face value in BTC and an annual rate. The price in dollars is calculated at the current BTC rate at the time of purchase.

cycle.title: Cycle and pause
cycle.text: After you stop a card, a 30-day pause starts. When it ends, the purchase price and fixed income are credited to the wallet. The card can't be restarted.

sell.title: Selling back
sell.text: A card that hasn't been started can be sold back to the service for its purchase price. Started, paused and finished cards can't be sold.

rate.title: Rate
rate.text: The annual rate is not guaranteed and may be changed by the service.

deposits.title: Deposits
deposits.text: You send BTC to the service address and submit the transaction hash. The administrator checks the transaction and credits the amount.

withdrawals.title: Withdrawals
withdrawals.text: Withdrawals are made in USDT (TRC20) to the address you specify, after the administrator confirms the request. Check the address carefully — transfers can't be reversed.

risk.title: Risks
risk.text: You may lose part or all of the funds. The service doesn't promise profit.

changes.title: Changes
changes.text: Terms may change. We'll let you know about important changes in the app.

privacy.title: Privacy
privacy.intro: What data we store and why.

data.title: What we store
data.text: Your Telegram ID, username, interface language, and the history of your operations and cards in the service.

use.title: Why
use.text: To sign you in, show your balance and cards, process requests and send notifications in the bot.

share.title: Who we share it with
share.text: We don't sell your data. We don't share it with third parties, except where required by law.

delete.title: Deleting data
delete.text: To delete your data, contact support.
